metadata.quantization_rule: same-relative-model; F1 repeated-large openings are family-first: representative family dimensions quantified once then replicated identically; other opening positions/extents nearest stud; wall height ratio 0.83 converted with 8.0 mm/stud and 3.2 mm/plate, then nearest whole brick course

f1_family_template.method: family-first representative template: width uses established common F1 width; height is the nearest integer brick-course quantization of the four-occurrence representative height (mean of the prior P1-derived occurrence estimates), then replicated identically

fidelity_issues.message: EXPERIMENTAL_SCALE_PROTOTYPE: 57-stud front-facade perceptual scale test only; not an official house module.
